title: Crab eats worms
description: A crab walks across the field and eats worms. Ideal for getting to know the editor: create actors, Act, call methods.

tasks.text: Right-click the world → "New: Krabbe" and "New: Wurm". Then press Act a few times.
Click the crab: its properties appear below. Right-click the crab → call fressen(menge). What happens to the attribute gefressen?
Change the crab's speed in the code (self.move(2)). What changes?
Create a class Hai with "New class …" that hunts the crab.
Give the crab an image: right-click the class in the diagram → "Set image …".
